facts.fact: The Lagos e-Birth platform, launched 13 November 2025, registers births at NPC offices, local government secretariats and primary healthcare centres, replacing handwritten entries, and links each newborn to the NIN, per the NPC Lagos commissioner.
The e-Birth platform described covers birth registration, per the NPC Lagos commissioner.
The NPC Lagos state director says Lagos has 144 functional registration centres, in health facilities and NPC and local government offices, with at least four in every local government area.

UNICEF and the Lagos State Government launched the e-Birth platform in Lagos on 13 November 2025, part of a nationwide rollout begun in 2024 that has also reached Nasarawa, Kano, Borno and Enugu, per the commissioner.
